more questions?
What exactly is MOTION?+

MOTION is a nicotine-free performance pouch made with seven active ingredients, including guarana, a source of caffeine. Each can contains 20 pouches.

Is there any nicotine or tobacco?+

No. MOTION pouches contain neither nicotine nor tobacco. They do contain caffeine. Always read the product label before use.

How do I use a pouch?+

Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum. Follow the directions on your can, and discard the pouch after use. Do not swallow it.

Can I mix the flavors?+

Yes. The MOTION shop lets you build a box with Blue Raspberry, Mint, and Mango. Choose a mix or stick with your favorite.

How does the subscription work?+

Choose Subscribe & Save in the MOTION shop for recurring deliveries. Review the current price and delivery schedule before checking out. You can skip, swap flavors, pause, or cancel through your account.
